r1.exp: 1=F (Ferdinand: 'I would need a GLOBAL COMPUTER CORPORATION on my side'). 2=E (Ebony: 'volunteer group... free worldwide distribution' = non-profit). 3=B (Benjamin: 'incorporated into SCHOOL SYSTEMS'). 4=A (Anna: 'my father runs a pharmaceutical company... FINANCIAL HELP IS GUARANTEED'). 5=F (Ferdinand: 'It DAWNED ON ME WHILE I WAS READING A NOVEL'). 6=C (Chris: 'INTEGRATED IN THE HUMAN BRAIN, combining biological and technological functions' = cybernetic). 7=E (Ebony: 'hopefully make everyone realise that humans aren't as HARD AS NAILS' = people are caring). 8=D (Daphne: 'I have already DUG INTO SCIENTIFIC LITERATURE about CLONING'). 9=C (Chris: 'would make... humans SMARTER'). 10=A (Anna: 'My DAD sparked the idea in me'). 11=B (Benjamin: 'get into PARLIAMENT'). 12=D (Daphne: 'I still have doubts about WHETHER IT IS ETHICAL').

r17.exp: 'I have some conflict about this' — 'this' refers to removing harnesses and chaining the dogs = A.

r18.exp: 'The group has MELDED WELL. Working with the dogs has given us a SHARED PURPOSE. The GOOD HUMOUR of the animals HAVE RUBBED OFF' = psi su zbližili grupu = B.

r19.exp: 'Worry too much about what people think. (19)____. Everyone has opinion, but it's based on their history.' → D: If you waste too much time seeking validation, you won't have time to accomplish all that you desire.

r20.exp: 'Clinging to past mistakes holds you back. (20)____. Consider them little things to let roll off your back.' → G: This goes to say that you can't influence unmet expectations, bygone difficult situations and failures.

r21.exp: 'Trudge through trenches before success clicks. (21)____. Failure is the mother of all success.' → A: Therefore, when you hear about an overnight triumph story, be aware of all of the work that came before.

r22.exp: 'Money does not equate to happiness. (22)____. It is simply a currency.' → H: Nor does it insulate you from pain, suffering and conflict or improve your relationships with those around you.

r23.exp: 'You will live upwards of 80 years. (23)____. But if you try to do everything at once, you'll burn out.' → C: That is more than a fine stretch to fit a whole host of wonderful endeavours into your life.

r24.exp: 'Build a network of friendly support. (24)____. But don't let them colour your experience.' → F: Evidently, dishonesty, disrespect, unhappiness and evil exist and you will have to deal with them.

r25.exp: 'Would raise sea levels IF THEY MELTED completely' — uvjetna rečenica 2. tipa: if + past simple → would. 'If they melted' (nerealni uvjet).

r26.exp: 'A survey FOUND that...' — 'find' uz 'that' = otkriti, pokazati (rezultati istraživanja).

r27.exp: '29 cm in this century ALONE' — 'alone' uz imenice/fraze = samo, isključivo (29 cm, and that's just for this century).

r28.exp: 'Increasing even FURTHER by 84 cm' — 'further' za apstraktno povećanje (more, beyond that).

r29.exp: 'Take the total to WELL OVER 100 centimetres' — 'well over' = znatno više od, dobrano iznad.

r30.exp: 'A rise in THE sea level' — određeni član 'the' uz 'sea level' (jedinstven, opće poznat pojam).

r31.exp: 'Not only... BUT additionally' — fiksni izraz: not only... but (also) = ne samo... nego i.

r32.exp: 'Respond TO increasing global temperatures' — fiksna prijedložna kolokacija: respond to = reagirati na.

r33.exp: 'BUT AFTER nearly three decades, Elfyn has decided to leave' — 'after' za period koji je prethodio odluci.

r34.exp: 'The producer HAS promised' — present perfect za relevantnu prošlu radnju.

r35.exp: 'Is being KEPT secret' — present continuous passive: be + being + kept (čuva se u tajnosti).

r36.exp: 'Involved IN several important story lines' — fiksna prijedložna kolokacija: be involved in = biti uključen u.

r37.exp: 'A cornerstone OF/IN/FOR the community' — sve tri opcije prihvatljive uz 'cornerstone'.

r38.exp: 'Will be ONE/SOMETHING that will be remembered' — 'one' ili 'something' za referiranje na nešto nespecifično ali nezaboravno.

r39.exp: 'Witness AN illness spreading' — neodređeni član 'an' ispred imenice koja počinje vokalom, ili 'severe/serious' kao pridjev.

r40.exp: 'Not brave ENOUGH to leave their homes' — 'enough' iza pridjeva: adj + enough + to-infinitive.

sol.rubric: Esej 200-250 riječi. ZA negativan utjecaj: potiče konzumerizam, nezdrave životne navike (brza hrana), nerealna tijela, manipulacija. ZA korisnu uslugu: informira o proizvodima, potiče ekonomiju, besplatni mediji. Vlastito mišljenje.

w1.exp: Esej — ručno se ocjenjuje. Diskusijski esej (discuss both views + opinion). Viša razina: akademski stil, 200–250 riječi.
